_note: What you see: A news article about Children's Book Week with photo, the facts block when, where and what to bring, the card to sign in and more news.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Een nieuwsbericht over de Kinderboekenweek met foto, het feitenblok wanneer, waar en wat mee, de kaart om in te loggen en meer nieuws.
Groep 8 las voor aan de kleuters, en de: Group 8 read to the infants, and the hall is full of drawings of favourite books. Until vrijdag 16 oktober the school is all about reading.
[FOTO: groep 8 leest voor aan de kleuter: [PHOTO: group 8 reads to the infants in the hall]
Woensdagochtend opende juf Hanneke de Ki: On woensdag morning juf Hanneke opened Children's Book Week on the playground. Then group 8 went to the infant classes. Each child from group 8 read a picture book of their own choice to a small group of infants.
De komende twee weken leest elke groep e: For the next two weeks every group reads a quarter of an hour longer each day. In the hall is a reading table with new books from the Zuiddrecht library. Children may read there during the break.
Op woensdag 14 oktober is de boekenmarkt: On woensdag 14 oktober is the book market. Children sell and swap books they have finished. Do you have spare children's books at home? Your child may bring them that day.
Op het grote plein. Bij regen in de hal: On the big playground. In the hall if it rains
Boeken om te ruilen, en een kleed om op: Books to swap, and a blanket to sit on
We zoeken nog vier ouders. Meld u aan bi: We are still looking for four parents. Sign up with the teacher
Heeft u een vraag over de Kinderboekenwe: Do you have a question about Children's Book Week? Send your child's teacher a message in
De leerkracht schrijft ook nieuws voor a: The teacher also writes news for their own group only. You read that after signing in.
